requirements.statement: An Account Manager can create and manage customers and their engagements

criteria.must: An Account Manager can create a customer with name and primary contact info
An Account Manager can create an engagement under a customer with name, description, and date range
An Account Manager can edit a customer or engagement they created
Any Account Manager can view any customer or engagement

requirements.statement: An Admin can maintain a directory of team members

criteria.must: An Admin can add a team member to the directory
An Admin can edit a team member's directory record
A Resource Manager can view the team member directory when assigning staff

requirements.statement: An Account Manager can submit an allocation request for an engagement specifying role, utilization %, and date range

criteria.must: An Account Manager can submit an allocation request specifying role, utilization %, and start/end dates
A submitted allocation request starts in Pending status
An allocation request cannot be submitted against a Closed engagement

requirements.statement: A Resource Manager can review pending allocation requests

criteria.must: A Resource Manager can view a list of pending allocation requests
A Resource Manager can view the details of a single allocation request

requirements.statement: A Resource Manager can assign a specific team member to fulfill an approved allocation request

criteria.must: A Resource Manager can assign a team member with role, utilization %, and date range to a request
Approving a request creates an allocation for the assigned team member
An approved request's status changes to Approved

requirements.statement: A Resource Manager can reject an allocation request with a reason

criteria.must: A Resource Manager can reject a pending allocation request with a reason
A rejected request's status changes to Rejected and stores the reason
The requesting Account Manager can see the rejection reason on the request

requirements.statement: A Resource Manager can view all current and upcoming allocations across engagements to spot over- or under-allocation

criteria.must: A Resource Manager can view a list of all current and upcoming allocations across engagements
The allocations list shows each allocation's team member, engagement, role, utilization %, and dates

requirements.statement: A Resource Manager can modify or end an existing allocation

criteria.must: A Resource Manager can modify an allocation's role, utilization %, or date range
A Resource Manager can end an allocation before its original end date

requirements.statement: A Team Member can view their own current and upcoming allocations across engagements

criteria.must: A Team Member can view a list of their own current and upcoming allocations
Each allocation shown to the Team Member includes the engagement, role, and utilization %
A Team Member cannot view another team member's allocations

requirements.statement: An Admin can view a utilization report across all team members

criteria.must: An Admin can view a report showing utilization % across all team members
The report reflects the sum of a team member's active allocation utilization %

requirements.statement: An Account Manager can define a staffing plan for an engagement with roles and target headcount

criteria.must: An Account Manager can add a role with a target headcount to an engagement's staffing plan
An Account Manager can revise an engagement's staffing plan at any time
Defining a staffing plan does not itself create any allocation

requirements.statement: An Account Manager can close an engagement so it no longer accepts new allocation requests

criteria.must: An Account Manager can close an Active engagement
A Closed engagement remains visible and its existing allocations are unaffected
An Account Manager can reopen a Closed engagement to Active

requirements.statement: Sign-in is via SSO through Thunder, the platform identity provider

criteria.must: An unauthenticated user is redirected to sign in before reaching any role's screens
A signed-in user only sees the screens and actions permitted by their role

requirements.statement: Relevant parties are notified by email of allocation-request and allocation-decision events

criteria.must: Resource Managers are notified by email when a new allocation request is submitted
The requesting Account Manager and the affected Team Member are notified by email when a request is approved and assigned
The requesting Account Manager is notified by email when a request is rejected
